facts.fact: Decree 2021-913 of 22 December 2021 adopts the Referentiel General d'Interoperabilite (RGI), annexed to it, a list of reference standards for e-administration systems covering technical protocols (IP, TCP, HTTP, SMTP, SOAP/REST web services), data formats and encodings (XML, JSON, XSD, PDF/A, UTF-8, geospatial formats), pivot data formats, and semantic key terms.

Article 3 of Decree 2021-913 states that public bodies are bound to conform to the RGI, making its technical, syntactic and semantic interoperability standards compulsory for their information systems.

systems.owner: Ministry of Digital Economy (now Digital Transition) and Ministry of Civil Service and Modernisation of Administration
systems.tiers: all public bodies (organismes publics); internal and external exchanges of the administration
